angle: The power series exp(x)=Σxⁿ/n! as a conveyor belt whose blocks each differentiate onto their left neighbour — showing the coefficients 1/n! are forced by f'=f and f(0)=1, that no finite sum can be self-derivative because differentiation always eats the top term, and that the ratio |x|/(n+1)→0 makes the infinite belt converge for every x; this supplies the EXISTENCE that artifact 02's uniqueness proof deferred.

libraries.name: katex
libraries.role: All mathematical notation: the staged derivation steps, slot labels under the belt rail, and crucially the live formula printed ON each moving block (xⁿ/n! → n·xⁿ⁻¹/n! → xⁿ⁻¹/(n−1)!). Rendered via katex.renderToString into a Map cache and swapped as innerHTML mid-animation.

libraries.name: gsap
libraries.role: The belt choreography as a sequenced timeline: brightness flash while each block shows its raw derivative, staggered one-slot slide left, the constant block falling into the →0 bin (x/y/opacity/scale/rotation), label simplification pulse, then the tail block entering from off-belt. Phases are awaited via timeline.then(). Also number-tweens coefficient values in the recurrence lab.

libraries.name: echarts
libraries.role: Five plots: (1) S_N−S_N′ from central finite differences overlaid with predicted x^N/N! scatter, (2) partial-sum family S_1..S_N against e^x with a dashed probe markLine, (3) term-magnitude bar chart on a log axis showing the hump at n≈|x|, (4) ratio |x|/(n+1) on a log axis with a markLine at 1, (5) |e−S_n| against the bound 1/(n!·n) on a log axis.

building_blocks: sticky-law-bar: thin sticky header holding the governing KaTeX equation plus a scroll-position label driven by IntersectionObserver over <section> elements

fold-down-section-scaffold: vertical stack of numbered sections (eyebrow chip + serif h2 + lead paragraph), each split left/right by grid-5-7 / grid-7-5 / grid2 utilities that collapse to one column under 900px
katex-render-pass: scan [data-tex] / [data-display] attributes once at boot, render through a memoised renderToString cache, plus setTex(el,str) for hot-swapping formulas during animation
katex-case-guard: `.katex, .katex * { text-transform:none }` so uppercase/small-caps UI labels never re-case rendered mathematics (an easy-to-miss bug)
staged-derivation-stepper: ordered list where each step carries prose + a display-mode KaTeX line, with prev/next buttons dimming future steps and fading completed ones

editable-coefficient-lab: grid of text inputs (a_0..a_7) with per-cell residual bar r_n = a_n − (n+1)a_{n+1}, per-cell 'already forced' badge, scramble/reset, single-step and run-all recurrence application via GSAP number tweens

conveyor-belt-widget: reusable Belt class — absolutely-positioned DOM blocks over a fixed slot rail, geometry recomputed from container width (slot width, block width, font size), model = {shift, blocks:[{origin,el,lab}]} with block `origin` sitting at slot `origin − shift`
belt-shift-timeline: the multi-phase GSAP sequence (highlight → stagger slide → dying-block drop into bin → simplify labels + slot match pulse → tail refill or wall)
finite-vs-infinite-contrast-pair: two instances of the same widget driven by one button, one with an infinite tail supply and one with a hard wall, so the failure mode is a direct visual A/B
verdict-banner: colour-coded (ok/no) status strip under a visualisation, mixing prose with an inline KaTeX claim that updates with state
readout-tile-grid: auto-fit grid of labelled numeric tiles with semantic colour (good/bad/accent/teal), an optional sub-line for provenance, and a .nocase escape for math-bearing labels
echarts-dark-theme-preset: baseOpt() + axis(o) merge helper (defaults first, caller's keys win) so custom log-axis label formatters are not clobbered
log-axis-magnitude-bars: per-bar itemStyle colouring to mark the peak term and the pre/post-peak regions, with zeros mapped to null so a log axis accepts them
identity-check-chart: plot a claimed closed form as scatter markers over an independently computed numerical curve, and report the max gap as an honesty readout
bigint-exact-rational-table: A_n = n·A_{n−1}+1 over n!, long-divided to a fixed number of decimals, with leading digits diff-highlighted against a reference constant
caveat-disclosure: <details> block styled as a warning that names the theorems being used without proof and the approximations being displayed
live-floating-point-failure-demo: same quantity computed two ways with relative errors and a predicted noise floor ε·max|term|, computed in-page rather than quoted
preset-segmented-control: button group that jumps a slider to notable values (x = 1, 5, 20, −20, 30) and keeps the active state in sync with manual dragging
responsive-relayout-hook: single resize listener that re-runs chart.resize() for all instances and recomputes belt geometry
computations: stable term recurrence t_0=1, t_n = t_{n−1}·x/n (avoids overflowing xⁿ and n! separately) — used for every term, partial sum and truncation error on the page
partial sums S_N(x) = Σ_{n=0}^{N} xⁿ/n! evaluated at 220 sample points per curve for the S_1..S_N family

independent derivative estimate by central difference [S_N(x+h) − S_N(x−h)]/2h with h = 1e−5, compared against the predicted deficit x^N/N!; the max gap (~2e−10) is reported as finite-difference noise
residuals r_k = a_k − (k+1)a_{k+1} of user-entered coefficients, and the recurrence a_{k+1} = a_k/(k+1) applied stepwise
detection that a user's coefficients satisfy a_n = a_0/n!, and the resulting identification f(x) = a_0·e^x
ratio test |x|/(n+1) per n, the crossing index min{n : |x|/(n+1) < 1}, the peak term index argmax|xⁿ/n!| and its magnitude (4.310e+7 at x = 20)
terms needed for a given relative tolerance at a given x (loop until |t_n| < rel·|S| and n > |x|)

exact BigInt partial sums of e: A_n = n·A_{n−1} + 1 with S_n = A_n/n!, long-divided to 24 exact decimal places, with leading digits compared character-by-character against e = 2.718281828459045235360287471…
error bound 1/(n!·n) versus the actual |e − S_n|, both plotted on a log axis

catastrophic cancellation: Σ(−20)ⁿ/n! summed directly in doubles (result 5.622e−9, 173% relative error, no correct digits) versus 1/Σ20ⁿ/n! (2.061153622e−9, 2.0e−16 relative error), plus the predicted noise floor ε·max|t_n| = 9.57e−9
numeric check of the addition law |S_30(x)·S_30(y) − S_30(x+y)| for user-entered x and y
interactions: step/back through the seven-line derivation that forces a_{k+1} = a_k/(k+1) and hence a_n = 1/n!
type arbitrary coefficients a_0..a_7; residual bars, 'forced' badges, total residual and the identified function update live
apply the recurrence one k at a time, or run all — coefficients are GSAP-tweened back onto 1/n! while the residual bars collapse to zero
press d/dx to shift both belts one slot: blocks slide left, the constant falls into the →0 bin, the infinite belt refills from the tail, the finite belt empties its top slot
reset both belts; drag the polynomial degree N (2..6) to rebuild the finite belt; drag the test point x to update p(x), p(x)−p′(x) and the series value
drag N (1..9) to redraw the deficit chart and the deficit-at-x=1 readout
drag N (1..14) and the probe x to move the partial-sum family, the probe markLine and the truncation-error tiles
drag x (−30..30) or hit the presets 1 / 5 / 20 / −20 / 30 to redraw the term-magnitude bars, the ratio curve, the peak index, the peak magnitude and the terms-to-converge count
type an exponent and recompute the direct-summation-versus-reciprocal cancellation table
type x and y to check exp(x+y) = exp(x)exp(y) numerically
expand the caveat disclosures listing the theorems assumed and the approximations displayed
assets: katex .woff2 fonts (20 files under lib/katex/fonts, referenced by katex.min.css via relative fonts/ paths)
no images, no icon fonts, no remote requests at view time
gotchas: file:// requires classic global/UMD script builds — GSAP dist/gsap.min.js and ECharts dist/echarts.min.js are UMD and load fine; ESM-only builds would have failed.
KaTeX's CSS resolves fonts relative to itself, so the whole katex/ directory (css + js + fonts/) must be copied intact; copying only katex.min.css silently falls back to system fonts.

A helper named `ax()` for merging ECharts axis defaults collided with a local `const ax = Math.abs(x)` inside the convergence renderer and threw 'ax is not a function', killing three of five charts. Renamed to `axis()`.
Object.assign(myAxisOptions, AX) puts the defaults LAST, so the shared AX.axisLabel silently overwrote the custom log-axis tick formatters. Fixed with axis(o) = Object.assign({}, AX, o).

UI labels styled `text-transform: uppercase` also uppercase KaTeX output — 'S_n' rendered as 'S_N', 'e^x' as 'E^x', 'p(x)' as 'P(X)'. Fixed globally with `.katex, .katex * { text-transform:none !important; letter-spacing:normal !important }` plus a `.nocase` class for plain-text labels containing mathematics.
ECharts log axes reject zero values: |xⁿ/n!| is exactly 0 at x = 0, so zeros are mapped to null (skipped) and the axis min is clamped to the smallest positive magnitude.
Computing xⁿ/n! literally overflows to Infinity/Infinity = NaN for modest n; every term on the page uses the recurrence t_n = t_{n−1}·x/n instead.

Headless Chrome with --virtual-time-budget barely fires requestAnimationFrame, so GSAP timelines stall and the belt appears frozen in --dump-dom checks. Verified instead by manually seeking gsap.globalTimeline.time(t) in a probe; real browsers are unaffected.

gsap.to(...).eventCallback('onComplete', fn) REPLACES an onComplete already set in the tween vars, silently dropping the commit step — the sequencer passes its continuation into the tween factory instead.
Chaining recurrence steps must read a_k at run time, not when the sequence is built, or every step tweens toward a stale target.
Absolutely-positioned belt blocks need geometry recomputed on resize (slot width, block width and the label font size), otherwise blocks overlap their neighbours on narrow viewports.
